description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552 (24/0860)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership (State vs. Private), parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
